_doc: Builds made by bench/build.sh, each from its own git worktree under $BENCH_WORK/src/<name>. 'ref' is resolved to a commit at build time and recorded in $BENCH_WORK/build/<name>/bench-build.json. kind=upstream builds with the upstream CMake files and is never modified; kind=new gets the phase-timing hooks if instrument=true. All builds use the same compiler and the same CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS; build.sh asserts that the optimization flags of LogGOPSim.cpp are identical.

base.description: Unmodified upstream spcl/LogGOPSim: the last upstream commit before this project (merge of PR #18)

master.description: Self-describing format v2, unified TraceReader, plan runners plan/jit/orc/templated_node/templated_schema

master-plain.description: master without phase-timing hooks: checks that the instrumentation changes nothing

omp.description: Parallel (OpenMP) txt2bin first pass, legacy writer with pwrite

lazy.description: --lazy-decoding (ready nodes as indices, dependency counters in memory, trace never written); includes omp-first-pass
